hypotheses.reasoning: A brief catalog-svc-1 restart (3/4 capacity for 30s, back to 4/4 at 08:57:40) caused a few 503s. search-api's CatalogClient retries right away with backoff disabled (up to 4 attempts), so it multiplies load on catalog-svc. Inbound rate climbed from 3.2x to 5.0x baseline and catalog-svc kept shedding load, which keeps the retry storm going even though the instance recovered. web-bff 503s are the downstream symptom. catalog-db and redis look healthy, and the TLS and index-worker GC warnings are unrelated.
catalog-svc queue full. More likely a symptom of the retries than an undersized limit.

verdict.recommendedAction: Turn on exponential backoff with jitter (and a retry budget or circuit breaker) in search-api CatalogClient. To clear the storm now, temporarily cap search-api retries or rate-limit them, and scale out catalog-svc.
